robot.title: Six-Axis Robot Offline Kinematic Calibration
robot.alt: Offline validation metrics and field-validation status for the six-axis robot calibration project
robot.metrics_alt: Offline validation metrics panel for the six-axis robot calibration project
robot.desc: An offline kinematic parameter calibration project for a six-axis industrial robot. It combines standard DH modeling, Kabsch/SVD registration, bounded nonlinear least squares, and repeated-split validation to identify parameters and assess coupling, stability, and identifiability.
robot.work: Kinematic modeling, parameter identification, validation design, stability analysis, GUI delivery, and project reporting.
robot.status_note: The offline software version is frozen; real-controller field validation remains pending.

paperforge.alt: A paper-analysis workflow connecting Zotero, PaperForge, agents, and Obsidian
paperforge.desc: PaperForge turns papers and PDFs from Zotero into traceable analysis workspaces, guides agents through structured evidence review, and exports the results to Obsidian as a long-term knowledge network.
paperforge.work: Workflow architecture, CLI design, research profiles, data boundaries, structural validation, Obsidian export, and documentation.
paperforge.tagline: A local-first workflow for deep paper analysis and long-term knowledge building

weather.title: Weather–Market Data Audit and Reproducible Research System
weather.alt: A weather and market research pipeline from collection and validation to partial ingestion and rejection traceability
weather.desc: A multi-city weather and market research pipeline evolved from an Excel logging prototype, using structured weekly packages, schemas, deterministic recalculation, partial ingestion, and rejection records to keep data traceable and auditable.
weather.work: Research protocol design, data structures, schemas, validation scripts, weekly ingestion, rejection traceability, and GitHub Actions validation.

codex.title: Codex Naiwa Pet — Windows Enhanced Edition
codex.alt: Sprite animation and Windows patch workflow for the enhanced Codex Naiwa desktop pet
codex.desc: A Windows enhancement of an open-source Codex desktop pet, adding interactive animations, local audio, and drag effects, supported by a delivery workflow with dry runs, compatibility validation, targeted ASAR patching, installation, and acceptance checks.
codex.work: Interaction enhancements, sprite processing, patch scripts, compatibility guards, MSIX packaging and installation, and acceptance procedures.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: My Engineering Focus
about.statement: I care not only about whether an algorithm works on ideal data, but whether it remains reliable under real hardware, measurement noise, cross-platform environments, and deployment constraints.

card1.title: Industrial Robotics & Automation
card1.desc: I study the sources of industrial robot accuracy through kinematic modeling, parameter identification, and validation, while continuing to develop practical knowledge of TCPs, coordinate systems, servo motion control, ROS2, and workstation integration.

card2.title: Research Engineering & Reproducibility
card2.desc: I design research tasks as traceable, reproducible, and auditable workflows, with clear distinctions between internal validation, external validation, failure records, and conclusions that remain unconfirmed.

card3.title: AI-assisted Engineering & Tooling
card3.desc: I use ChatGPT for problem decomposition, solution design, and review, delegate repository and environment execution to agents, and constrain generated results through Git, pull requests, acceptance criteria, and deterministic tests.
